The '''2026 United States Senate election in Massachusetts''' will be held on November 3, 2026, to elect a member of the [[United States Senate]] to represent the [[Commonwealth of Massachusetts]]. [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] incumbent [[Ed Markey]] is seeking a third full term. He is being challenged by [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] attorney [[John Deaton]].

[[Primary election]]s were held on September 1. Markey won the Democratic nomination over congressman [[Seth Moulton]] with 64.9% of the vote. Deaton, the Republican nominee in [[2024 United States Senate election in Massachusetts|2024]], was nominated a second time after running unopposed in the primary.

Republicans have not won a Senate election in Massachusetts since [[2010 United States Senate special election in Massachusetts|2010]].
